actions.text: The EU’s new AI framework is a necessary step toward safer, more accountable AI — especially for high-risk applications. Its risk-based approach forces firms to prioritize governance, transparency, and impact assessments, which should reduce harms and increase public trust. That said, enforcement mechanisms and support for smaller companies will be critical. Policymakers should pair clear standards with practical guidance and phased compliance timelines so startups can innovate without being disproportionately burdened. Finally, meaningful avenues for redress and independent audits will ensure the rules don’t just sit on paper but actually improve outcomes for users.
